subject: bed socks
title: What If You Always Slept With Socks On?

scenes.text: What if you always slept with socks on? Warmer feet would actually cool you down.
In your first minutes in bed, warm feet open up their blood vessels and start dumping heat.
That heat loss lowers your core temperature, the signal your body uses to tell your brain it's time to sleep.
In one small study, sock wearers fell asleep about 7.5 minutes faster, with feet 1.3 degrees warmer.
Over the night, they woke about seven fewer times and slept roughly 32 minutes longer.
Swiss researchers found the best predictor of falling asleep fast was how well your hands and feet shed heat.
